{{quotation|[[gw.dat]]|Headquarters of the [[Istan]]i [[Council of Elders (Istani)|government]], used for diplomatic relations with [[Vabbi]] and [[Kourna]]. The [[Clanmarshal (Istan)|Clanmarshal]] has his offices here.}}

The [[Consulate]], also referred to as the '''Istani Consulate''', appears to be the seat of power of the [[Istan]]i [[Governments of Tyria|government]]. Affairs related to matters of state and security are conducted here, including public hearings and tribunals. [[Elder Suhl]] is currently the appointed leader of Istan's Council of Elders and [[Assistant Hahnna]] assists him in managing day-to-day affairs.

This is a small enclosed location where several primary quests take place.

==Getting there==
From [[Kamadan]], the eastern exit (leading into a building) between the [[Plains of Jarin]] exit and the [[Sun Docks]] exit leads here. Entering from [[Consulate Docks (outpost)|Consulate Docks]] is also possible although you first have to unlock that [[outpost]].

==Exits==
*[[Consulate Docks (outpost)|Consulate Docks]] (east, by talking to [[Assistant Hahnna]] ''but only'' during the quest [[the Time is Nigh]])
*[[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] (west)

==Quests available==

**[[To Vabbi!]] {{quest icon|primary}}

==Notes==
*The quest-only location known as [[the Tribunal]] appears as a replica of this location. That area is only accessible during [[Trial by Fire]].

==Trivia==
*With a total 396.5 pixels—the smallest data currently known—Consulate  is both the single smallest explorable area in Nightfall and the smallest across the entirety of Guild Wars.
*Exploration of this area provides 0.007% toward the [[Elonian Cartographer]] title.
